title: Panic when invoking search
body:
<!-- Your issue may already be reported!
Please search on the issue tracker before creating one. -->

### Reproduction steps

1. Open a file
2. Press `/` to search
3. Start typing

### Environment

- Platform: Arch Linux
- Helix version: v0.5.0-39-gcfc8285
